tagline: Compare gutter cleaning & repair quotes across Oxfordshire and the Thames Valley
subTagline: Free, no-obligation quotes from vetted local gutter cleaners, uPVC and cast iron repair specialists - covering Oxford, Reading, Bath, Cheltenham and 15+ towns across the South Midlands and Thames Valley.
disclosureText: Oxford Gutter Cleaning is an independent quote comparison service. We do not carry out cleaning or repair work ourselves - we connect Oxfordshire and Thames Valley homeowners with vetted, independently-operated local specialists.

reassurance.title: Genuinely independent
reassurance.text: We're not tied to any cleaning firm or roofline installer. We don't push one specialist over another - our only job is matching you with a fair local quote.

reassurance.title: Vetted local network
reassurance.text: Every specialist covering your postcode is checked for public liability insurance, IPAF or PASMA where working at height, and independent Trustpilot / Checkatrade reviews before they see a single lead.

reassurance.title: Workmanship guarantees
reassurance.text: Matched quotes include a written workmanship guarantee - typically 12 months on cleaning and minor repairs, and up to 10 years on new gutter runs from the manufacturer.

reassurance.title: No cold calls, no data resale
reassurance.text: Your details go to the 2-3 specialists we match you with, once. We never share, sell or reuse them beyond that quote.

faq.question: How much does gutter cleaning cost around Oxford and the Thames Valley?
faq.answer: Based on typical 2024-2025 market rates in the region, a standard clean runs from around £60-£90 for a mid-terrace in Cowley or East Reading, £80-£120 for a two-bed semi in Kidlington or Woodley, and £140-£220 for a large detached in North Oxford, Sonning or the Cotswolds - price mainly tracks gutter length, height and how blocked they are. Compare free quotes to get an exact figure for your postcode.

faq.question: Do you cover cast iron and heritage guttering in conservation areas?
faq.answer: Yes - Oxford's 17 conservation areas, Bath's UNESCO frontages and Cheltenham's Regency terraces all typically require cast iron or cast aluminium replacements rather than uPVC on street-facing façades. We match those jobs to specialists who work specifically on heritage rainwater goods with the correct code 4/5 lead flashings, sand:cement or lime mortar bedding, and paint-finish spec.

faq.question: Is this service really free?
faq.answer: Yes, comparing quotes through us is completely free for homeowners. We're funded by a referral fee paid by specialists when they receive a quote request, which keeps quotes unbiased since there's no incentive to push one firm over another.

faq.question: How quickly can someone come out?
faq.answer: For blocked-gutter jobs in Oxford, Reading, Bicester, Abingdon and Witney we typically match you with a specialist who can attend within 48-72 hours. For repair and replacement work the standard lead time is 1-2 weeks, longer in autumn peak season (October to early December) when leaf-drop demand hits its yearly high.

faq.question: Are your gutter specialists vetted?
faq.answer: We only accept specialists who meet our vetting criteria into our network - checks include £2m public liability insurance minimum, IPAF or PASMA competency for anything above single-storey, evidence of workmanship guarantees, and independent reviews on at least one third-party platform (Trustpilot, Checkatrade, Which? Trusted Traders or Google).
